import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    blks=[(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1) if inp[r][c]==inp[r][c+1]==inp[r+1][c]==inp[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for br,bc in blks:
        # markers around this block, in order TL,TR,BR,BL
        mk=[(br-1,bc-1),(br-1,bc+1),(br+1,bc-1),(br+1,bc+1)]
        cols=[inp[mr][mc] for mr,mc in mk]
        # rotate CW: new color at position i = old color at position (i-1) mod 4
        newcols=[cols[(i-1)%4] for i in range(4)]
        for (mr,mc),nc in zip(mk,newcols):
            dr=(mr>br)-(mr<br); dc=(mc>bc)-(mc<bc)
            rr,cc=mr+dr,mc+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if out[rr][cc] in (0,2): out[rr][cc]=nc
                else: break
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(p, f(G[p+' input'])==G[p+' output'])

import os,re,json,math
def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    blks=[(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1) if inp[r][c]==inp[r][c+1]==inp[r+1][c]==inp[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # assign markers to nearest block; markers are cells !=0,2
    mks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    for br,bc in blks:
        owned=[]

            d=min(abs(r-br),abs(r-bc+0.5),abs(r-(br+1)))**2+min(abs(c-bc)**2,abs(c-(bc+1))**2,abs(c-bc+0.5)**2)
            # simple chebyshev distance to block cell
            d=min(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-b)) for a in range(br,min(br+2,h)) for b in range(bc,min(bc+2,w)))
            dist=((r-br)**2+(c-bc)**2)+(((r-br)*(c-bc))and 0)
            owned.append((r,c,dist,v))
        # pick nearest markers (should be 4 diagonal-neighbors)
        owned.sort(key=lambda p:p[2])
        pts=[o[:3] for o in owned[:4]]
        # rotate config 90 CW about block center (3.5,3.5 etc.)
        cr,cc=br+0.5,bc+0.5
        rot={}
        for r,c,v in pts:
            dr,dc=r-cr,c-cc
            nr,nc=cr+dc,cc-dr
            # snap to integer cell (round)
            nrv,ncc=int(round(nr)),int(round(nc))
            rot[(nrv,ncc)]=v
        for (mr,mc),v in rot.items():
            dr=(mr>br)-(mr<br); dc=(mc>bc)-(mc<bc)
            rr,cc=mr+dr,mc+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:

                else: break
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# collect marker->ray-color & direction observations
obs=[]
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[p+' input']; O=G[p+' output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    blks=[(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1) if I[r][c]==I[r][c+1]==I[r+1][c]==I[r+1][c+1]==2]
    mks=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # nearest block per marker (min chebyshev dist to block cells)
    for r,c,v in mks:
        b=min(blks,key=lambda b:min(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-bd)) for a in range(b[0],b[0]+2) for bd in range(b[1],b[1]+2)))
        br,bc=b
        q=('TL' if r<br else 'BR')+( 'T' if c<bcc else 'B')
        obs.append((p,q,r,c,v,br,bc))
print(obs)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# For each demo: list blocks, marker positions (non-zero non-two), expected-painted bg cells grouped by color line.
for i in range(1,5):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; e=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    blks=[(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1) if inp[r][c]==2 and inp[r][c+1]==2 and inp[r+1][c]==2 and inp[r+1][c+1]==2]
    marks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=0 and inp[r][c]!=2]
    print('demo',i,'blocks',blks)
    # lines: cells (bg->painted) per color
    for col_ in sorted(set(e[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==0 and e[r][c]!=0)):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==0 and e[r][c]==col_]
        print('  color',col_,'count',len(pts),pts[:40])

# The rule that matched demos 1,3,4 exactly (and demo2 with only 2 stray cells) is:
# - find 2x2 blocks of 2s
# - each block has 4 corner markers at diagonal offsets (-1,-1),(-1,+2),(+2,-1),(+2,+2)
# - each marker is recolored to its counter-clockwise neighbor corner's color
#   (tl<-bl, tr<-tl, br<-tr, bl<-br) — i.e. each marker adopts the color of the
#    preceding corner in counter-clockwise order
# - each recolored marker emits a diagonal ray away from the block (up-left/up-right/down-left/down-right)
# - the ray paints every background cell along that diagonal until the grid edge, stopping at 2-blocks
def f(inp):
    inp=[r[:] for r in inp]; h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    off={'tl':(-1,-1),'tr':(-1,2),'bl':(2,-1),'br':(2,2)}
    away={'tl':(-1,-1),'tr':(-1,1),'bl':(1,-1),'br':(1,1)}
    cw=['tl','tr','br','bl']; prev={cw[i]:cw[(i-1)%4] for i in range(4)}  # recolor marker with CCW-neighbor's color
    for br,bc_ in [(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1)
          if inp[r][c]==2 and inp[r][c+1]==2 and inp[r+1][c]==2 and inp[r+1][c+1]==2]:
        for nm in ['tl','tr','bl','br']:
            p=(br+off[nm][0],bc_+off[nm][1])
            ref=(br+off[prev[nm]][0],bc_+off[prev[nm]][1])
            col_=inp[ref[0]][ref[1]]
            out[p[0]][p[1]]=col_
            rr,cc=p[0]+away[nm][0],p[1]+away[nm][1]
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and inp[rr][cc]!=2:
                out[rr][cc]=col_
                rr+=away[nm][0]; cc+=away[nm][1]
    return out
res=f(G['Test input'])
import json; print(json.dumps(res))
